Gambler.text: Huge geometric rectangular yellow-gold architectural earrings and a rigid segmented gold choker, sharply defined true gold with crisp metallic reflections.
Enormous stiff upright charcoal-purple collar rises beside the head; exceptionally broad red-orange shoulder panels with dark navy edges.
Dark navy lapels converge at a small tilted two-piece gold clasp over a fitted silver-gray bodice.
Voluminous deep burgundy sleeves with wide cuffs.
Large angular geometric gold rings and chunky rigid gold bracelet cuffs, with crisp true-metal reflections.
Asymmetric orange-red fabric on her RIGHT, partly covered at the hip by pale gray fabric; wider flared silver-gray fabric on her LEFT.
The asymmetric orange-red and silver-gray lower panels extend to the floor.
Black shoes with bright gold trim.

Protector.text: Oversized angular black helmet with a projecting brow and SOLID DARK FACEPLATE COMPLETELY CONCEALING THE EYES; narrow red visor markings, triangular red vents and red-and-white upper-edge accents. Only the lower face is exposed.
Massive angular charcoal and midnight-blue shoulder plates with bright red-orange edge accents.
Layered charcoal, midnight-blue and muted-purple chest armor, overlapping protective plates, rectangular compartments, dark straps and a wide diagonal black harness.
Thick gray sleeves with reinforced elbows and red-orange elbow accents.

Heavy dark-gray tactical gloves. A black baton and a transparent riot shield belong to this character; crop these props naturally at the image edge when only their upper sections are visible. Shield has silver-metal framing, blue-gray transparent panels, angular supports and a horizontal black rectangle bordered in vivid red.
Broad utility belt with attached pouches.
Rigid hip guards with red-orange accents over baggy gray combat trousers.
Reinforced gray trouser thighs, segmented knee protection and dark straps.
Armored shin panels on the gray combat trousers.

Bureaucrat Female.text: High black turtleneck and one small geometric pale-gold earring.
Structured charcoal-gray shoulders and broad overlapping charcoal-gray wrap lapels. One shoulder has a short blue covering edged in gold.
Charcoal-gray asymmetrical wrap bodice with gray borders and a small rectangular gold official insignia.
One arm has a dark-gray sleeve with a broad black cuff; the other has a fitted blue segmented sleeve with angular seams.
A restrained metallic gold wrist bracelet belongs only to the arm with the blue segmented sleeve.
Fitted waist fastened by a narrow belt with a square gold clasp.
Asymmetrical dark-charcoal front skirt panel with gray borders over a vivid orange underlayer.
Flowing vivid orange underskirt and charcoal front panel extend to the ankles; black stockings.
Dark blue-gray square-toed loafers with low heels.

Bureaucrat Male.text: High black turtleneck and one small geometric pale-gold stud earring.
Broad overlapping charcoal-gray lapels and squared structured shoulders; left shoulder has a short blue covering edged in pale gold. Straight masculine formal tailoring.
Asymmetrical charcoal-gray official-uniform coat over a broad flat chest, with a small rectangular pale-gold insignia. Straight, lightly tapered male tailoring.
RIGHT arm has a dark-gray sleeve and broad black cuff. LEFT arm has a fitted blue segmented sleeve with angular seams.
Restrained rigid pale-gold cuff on the LEFT wrist only.
Narrow formal black belt with square gold clasp at the natural waist; straight male silhouette rather than a tightly cinched waist.
Separated charcoal coat panels open over straight-cut charcoal tailored trousers, with a clearly distinct two-leg silhouette. Slim vivid orange inset and orange inner lining.
Straight charcoal trouser legs visible between separated coat panels, never a skirt.
Long asymmetrical charcoal panels with gray borders approach the ankles. Vivid orange lining visible in the opening and side vent; plain black socks.
Dark blue-gray square-toed men's formal loafers with flat low-profile soles.

Cheater.text: Black baseball cap with a curved brim and two small vertical gray markings on the front.
Small silver dangling earrings, layered black chokers and a delicate necklace with a metallic pendant.
Slate-gray bomber shoulders with dark panels and a large hood lined in crimson red.
Open oversized slate-gray bomber jacket with bright orange lining accents and gold zippers over a fitted black top with asymmetric straps.
Black cropped top ends in a decorative band beneath the bust, exposing the toned abdomen and navel.
Low-rise loose charcoal-black cargo pants with a wide black belt and rectangular buckle.
Large cargo thigh pockets, horizontal gold zipper and layered charcoal trouser panels.
Loose charcoal-black trouser legs gathered at the ankles.
Black ankle-high boots with burgundy-red vertical accents and thick light-gray soles.

Rebel.text: Red-orange round-lensed goggles rest around his neck against the cobalt-blue shirt; they are not worn over his eyes.
Tall open olive-green military coat collar and broad softly structured olive shoulders.

Open oversized olive-green military coat, large chest pockets and cobalt-blue shirt. Black tactical chest harness carries a rectangular orange panel and a large black utility pouch with small red accents.
Softly rumpled olive-green sleeves and dark cuffs.
One hand wears a black fingerless tactical glove.
Baggy dark-burgundy cargo trousers with an orange hanging utility strap.
Dark-burgundy trouser legs with a narrow red stripe and large red block lettering on one leg.
Open olive trench coat extends below the knees with wide off-white reflective stripes near its lower hem.
Heavy dark-brown combat boots with thick soles, reinforced toes and wide ankle straps.

Inventor.text: Standing charcoal utility-jacket collar over a dark ribbed turtleneck.
Black reinforced shoulder panels on a charcoal-gray utility jacket.
Charcoal-gray utility jacket with two dark-brown rectangular chest pockets and a red central zipper.
Rolled utility-jacket sleeves with thick cream cuffs, adapted to the permanent LEFT-arm prosthesis.

The intact RIGHT hand holds a separate detachable forearm-length tool: elongated red mechanical forearm section, proximal coupling connector, black hinges, cyan accents and THREE broad flat angular hooked prongs. This tool is separate from the permanent LEFT prosthesis; its docking socket remains EMPTY. If the tool extends beyond a crop, show only its visible part without zooming out.
Dark tactical trouser legs with orange-trimmed knee pads.
